title: Around town: taxis, buses & ride apps
goal: Hail and haggle with a taxi, tell the driver where to turn and where to drop you, get on the right bus or micro, book a ride on an app, and ask how far and how long.
intro:
Getting around Kathmandu means taxis that rarely use the meter, crowded **micros** and buses with a **खलासी** hanging out of the door shouting the route, electric **टेम्पो**s, and — more and more — motorbike rides booked on **Pathao** or **inDrive**. This unit gives you the words and the confidence to use all of them.

The grammar is the **compound verb**: a main verb plus a helper that adds a shade of meaning. **पुर्‍याइदिनुस्** 'please take me (for me)', **झारिदिनुस्** 'please drop me', **चढिहाल्नुस्** 'hop on quick', **जाँदै गर्नुस्** 'you go on ahead'. You'll also learn to ask how far and how long: **पुग्न कति समय लाग्छ?**

grammar.title: Compound verbs: -इदिनु, -इहाल्नु, -दै गर्नु
grammar.body:
Nepali often adds a **helper verb** to a main verb. The main verb takes **-इ** (stem + इ: रोक**ि**, झार**ि**, पुर्‍या**इ**, चढ**ि**), and the helper carries the tense, person and politeness. The helper doesn't change the basic meaning — it adds a shade:

**-इदिनु** 'do it **for** someone': the favour form (unit 18), and the natural way to ask a driver for anything: **पुर्‍याइदिनुस्** 'take me (please)', **झारिदिनुस्** 'drop me (please)', **रोकिदिनुस्** 'stop (for me)'. Without it, रोक्नुस् is a bare instruction — fine, but brisker.

**-इहाल्नु** 'go ahead and…, do it right away': **चढिहाल्नुस्** 'hop on (quick)', म **आइहाल्छु** 'I'll be right there', **बोलाइहाल** 'just call one (now)'.

**-दै गर्नु** 'keep (on) doing; go ahead and do': तपाईं **जाँदै गर्नुस्**, म आउँछु 'you go on ahead, I'll come', सिधै **जाँदै गर्नुस्** 'keep going straight'.

**-इसक्नु** 'already' (unit 17) is the same pattern: मैले पठाओ **बोलाइसकेँ** 'I've already called a Pathao'.

A handful of verbs come in pairs where the second means 'make someone/something do it': पुग्नु 'arrive' → **पुर्‍याउनु** 'take someone there'; झर्नु 'get down' → **झार्नु** 'let down'; घुम्नु 'go around' → **घुमाउनु** 'turn, show around'; मोडिनु 'turn' → **मोड्नु** 'turn (the car)'.

grammar.title: How far and how long: लाग्छ, पुगिन्छ
grammar.body:
Time and money a journey 'takes' are both **लाग्नु** 'to be applied, to take':

**समय लाग्छ** 'it takes time': पुग्न **कति समय लाग्छ**? 'how long does it take to get there?' — answer: बीस मिनेट **लाग्छ**. Past: दुई घण्टा **लाग्यो** 'it took two hours'. Guess: आधा घण्टा **लाग्ला** 'it'll probably take half an hour'.
**भाडा लाग्छ** 'the fare is': ट्याक्सीमा कति **भाडा लाग्छ**? 'how much is it by taxi?'

The purpose goes in the **-न** form before it: पुग्**न**, जा**न**, बना**उन** … कति लाग्छ?

'**Within** (a time)' is **-मा**: दस मिनेट**मा** पुग्छु 'I'll be there in ten minutes'.

For 'one gets there / you can…' Nepali uses the **impersonal passive -इन्छ**: बाइकमा आधा घण्टा**मा पुगिन्छ** 'by bike you get there in half an hour'; हिँडेर **जान सकिन्छ** 'you can walk there'.

Distance: **कति टाढा छ?** 'how far is it?' — पाँच किलोमिटर **जति** 'about five km', **नजिकै छ** 'it's close by', पैदल दस मिनेट 'ten minutes on foot'.

dialogue.title: A taxi to Boudha
dialogue.setting: Sarah, a British volunteer, flags down a taxi in Thamel one evening to get to Boudha.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.native: आठ सय? धेरै बढी भयो दाइ। पठाओमा त चार सय मात्र देखाउँछ।
lines.roman: āṭh saya? dherai baḍhi bhayo dāi. Paṭhāomā ta chār saya mātra dekhāuṃchha.
lines.en: Eight hundred? That's way too much. Pathao only shows four hundred.

lines.speaker: Driver
lines.native: बहिनी, बेलुकाको समय, जाम पनि छ। छ सय दिनुस्।
lines.roman: bahini, belukāko samaya, jām pani chha. chha saya dinus.
lines.en: It's evening, there's traffic too. Give me six hundred.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.native: पाँच सय दिन्छु, नत्र म पठाओ बोलाउँछु।
lines.roman: pāṃch saya dinchhu, natra ma Paṭhāo bolāuṃchhu.
lines.en: I'll give you five hundred, otherwise I'll get a Pathao.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.en: How long will it take to get to Boudha, do you think?

lines.speaker: Driver
lines.native: जाम भएन भने पच्चीस मिनेट जति।
lines.roman: jām bhaena bhane pachchis mineṭ jati.
lines.en: If the traffic isn't bad, about twenty-five minutes.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.native: दाइ, अलि बिस्तारै चलाउनुस् न, डर लाग्यो!
lines.roman: dāi, ali bistārai chalāunus na, ḍar lāgyo!
lines.en: Could you drive a bit slower? I'm scared!

lines.speaker: Driver
lines.native: हाहा, चिन्ता नगर्नुस्, म बीस वर्षदेखि ट्याक्सी चलाउँछु।
lines.roman: hāhā, chintā nagarnus, ma bis barsadekhi ṭyāksi chalāuṃchhu.
lines.en: Haha, don't worry, I've been driving a taxi for twenty years.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.en: OK, drop me at the gate up ahead, please.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.native: हजार दिएँ, पाँच सय फिर्ता दिनुस् त।
lines.roman: hajār dieṃ, pāṃch saya phirtā dinus ta.
lines.en: Here's a thousand — five hundred back, please.

culture: Kathmandu taxis have meters, but most drivers quote a price instead — agree on the fare **before** you get in, and don't be shy to bargain or to mention what the app shows. Drivers, conductors and shopkeepers are addressed as **दाइ** (older brother) or **भाइ** (younger brother); women as **दिदी** or **बहिनी** — using these instead of तपाईं alone sounds warm and natural, and drivers will call you बहिनी or भाइ back. Public buses and **micros** are cheap but packed at rush hour; the **खलासी** takes the fare (have small notes) and you tell him or the driver where to stop. Give up your seat to elders, and note the seats marked for women. Pathao and inDrive bike rides are the fastest way through traffic — you'll be handed a helmet. Strikes (**बन्द**) can stop all traffic for a day, and Kathmandu roads close for festivals and rallies, so ask friends **आज बाटो खुला छ?** before setting off.

lessons.title: Hailing a taxi and haggling

tip.title: Taxi talk
tip.body:
- Hail with **दाइ, … जाने?** and agree the price first: **कति लिनुहुन्छ?**
- Bargain gently: **अलि बढी भयो**, then offer a number.
- With drivers use the relaxed polite **-नुस्**: दिनुस्, जानुस्, रोक्नुस्.
- Call the driver **दाइ** (or **भाइ** if he's younger).

lessons.title: Telling the driver where to go

tip.title: Compound verbs: -इदिनु, -इहाल्नु, -दै गर्नु
tip.body:
- Stem + **इ** + helper. The helper takes the ending.
- **-इदिनु** 'for me' — the polite way to ask a driver: पुर्‍या**इदिनुस्**, झार**िदिनुस्**, रोक**िदिनुस्**.
- **-इहाल्नु** 'right away': चढ**िहाल्नुस्**!
- **-दै गर्नु** 'go on (doing)': जाँ**दै गर्नुस्** 'you go ahead'.

lessons.title: On the bus, micro and tempo

tip.title: Buses and micros
tip.body:
- Ask the **खलासी** (conductor) — he shouts the route and takes the fare. Have small notes.
- 'Does it go to…?': यो बस … **जान्छ**?
- To get off: **दाइ, रोक्नुस्!** — or ask him to tell you: … पुगेपछि **भन्नुस् है**.
- Offer your **सिट** to elders.

tip.title: It takes…: लाग्छ
tip.body:
- Time and fares 'take': बीस मिनेट **लाग्छ**, भाडा कति **लाग्छ**? Past **लाग्यो**.
- Put the purpose in **-न**: पुग्**न** कति लाग्छ?
- 'Within': आधा घण्टा**मा**.
- 'One gets there': **पुगिन्छ**; 'you can': जान **सकिन्छ**.
- 'About': पाँच किलोमिटर **जति**.
